question.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $795$ and $330.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}795 & = & 330(2) & + & 135 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 330 & = & 135(2) & + & 60 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 135 & = & 60(2) & + & 15 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 60 & = & 15(4) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $15.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $795$ and $330$ is $15.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(795,330)=15.
$$
